# `img`

Helper: `img(label, { icon, h })`  
Kit (`src/ui`): kit gap · status: kit gap  
App (KMP `core:ui`): none

## Anatomy

Rounded neutral box with an icon and a label.

## Variants

- Height by `h`

## States

- Static: it has no hover, focus or disabled state of its own

## Tokens

tile, line, ink-soft, brand-500 (icon, 60%)

## Do

- Use where a real image will go

## Don't

- Do not use it as a photo of a person

## Web (1440 and 1920)

Fixed height.

## Mobile (390)

Same as 1440; the frame is narrower, nothing is hidden.
